diasAdmin.ayuda: Tap a date to change when its registration opens, subscriber access, and the spots in each time slot.

diasAdmin.guardaParaCodigo: Save changes to generate the code.

apellidos.NUMEROS: Last names do not contain numbers.
apellidos.SIMBOLOS: Use letters only. Spaces, hyphens (-) and apostrophes (') are fine.
apellidos.CORTO: Write your full last name, not just one letter.

correo.SIN_USUARIO: The part before the @ is missing.
